dedupe_keys.name: long term unit commitment instances for district heating networks

description: This data set gives two benchmark instances of long-term unit commitment problems for district heating networks. It was published on Zenodo in March 2025 by Stephanie Riedmüller, Annika Buchholz and Janina Zittel through the Berlin MATH+ Cluster of Excellence. Each instance is based on a graph topology of a heating network and includes time series of the relevant energy markets; both are the size of a large city, with time series of 10 and 25 years. Coverage is two city-scale instances whose locations are not stated. The data are one zipped archive of about 235 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the abstract is short, so file formats and assumptions must be read from the archive. Simulation uses are testing optimisation methods for long-horizon dispatch and investment of heat generators and storage in district heating. Related records: data-opendhn-verbier-meshed-district-heating-benchmark is a measured district heating benchmark.
